chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from Dāwūd ibn Sirḥān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Concerning a man who forgot the adhan and the iqamah until he had entered into the salat (prayer).
He said: “There is nothing upon him.”

key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer made before the salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةَ: the second call signaling the immediate commencement of the salat (prayer)
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ: no penalty, blame, or remedial action is due upon him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets the adhan and iqamah until after starting the salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets the adhan and iqamah until after beginning the salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام states that no liability or corrective measure is upon him, indicating the prayer remains valid despite this omission.
